fact_text: Khazanay's co-founder said the brand started online in 2015 and by 2025 had four outlets nationwide: two in Karachi, plus Lahore and Islamabad.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Sunday Bazar to Nationwide Retail: Khazanay’s Journey | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-04)

fact_text: Khazanay sells graded, imported used shoes, a model that grew out of Karachi's Sunday bazaar in DHA Phase 8, where shoppers sought original and branded imports.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Sunday Bazar to Nationwide Retail: Khazanay’s Journey | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-04)

fact_text: The co-founder said Khazanay grades shoes by quality and prices higher grades higher, and that its prices remain below local-market equivalents for the same product.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Sunday Bazar to Nationwide Retail: Khazanay’s Journey | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-04)

fact_text: Khazanay offers a seven-day return policy, which the co-founder said local used-shoe shops usually do not, a point of difference for customers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Sunday Bazar to Nationwide Retail: Khazanay’s Journey | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-04)

fact_text: The co-founder said the dollar was about PKR 116 when Khazanay made its first import in 2015.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Sunday Bazar to Nationwide Retail: Khazanay’s Journey | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-04)

fact_text: Khazanay said a product sold for about PKR 34,000 at its 2015 start sells for about PKR 89,000 in 2025, driven by the dollar rate, rents and electricity bills.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Sunday Bazar to Nationwide Retail: Khazanay’s Journey | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-04)

fact_text: An import retailer's landed price moves with the exchange rate between order and arrival, and duties are also paid in dollars, so cost can shift while goods are in transit.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Sunday Bazar to Nationwide Retail: Khazanay’s Journey | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-04)

fact_text: When dollar shortages led to import restrictions around 2023, Khazanay stored stock in a third country and resumed Pakistan imports once the restriction eased.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Sunday Bazar to Nationwide Retail: Khazanay’s Journey | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-04)

fact_text: When Pakistan's dollar reserves run short, import bans can stop shipments, and customs duties and other taxes add to the cost of imports.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Sunday Bazar to Nationwide Retail: Khazanay’s Journey | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-04)

fact_text: The FY26 budget brought some customs duty relaxation, according to the co-founder of Khazanay.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Sunday Bazar to Nationwide Retail: Khazanay’s Journey | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-04)

fact_text: The co-founder said the regulatory duty was expected to be removed and products would later move to flat duties, which he described as a positive step.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Sunday Bazar to Nationwide Retail: Khazanay’s Journey | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-04)

fact_text: Khazanay's main investment is inventory, and supply is outside its control because it imports rather than manufactures, which makes sourcing a key challenge.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Sunday Bazar to Nationwide Retail: Khazanay’s Journey | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-04)

fact_text: Khazanay plans further Karachi expansion and one outlet each in Multan, Sialkot, Faisalabad and Gujranwala, and says its growth plan is physical retail.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Sunday Bazar to Nationwide Retail: Khazanay’s Journey | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-04)

fact_text: Khazanay started with a small sum from the co-founder's brother, also a co-founder, and reinvested profits in stock; the co-founder said it took about ten years, from 2015, to reach its current scale.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Sunday Bazar to Nationwide Retail: Khazanay’s Journey | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-04)

fact_text: The co-founder said Khazanay aimed to be profitable from day one, arguing that businesses run for funding headlines rather than for profit do not last.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Sunday Bazar to Nationwide Retail: Khazanay’s Journey | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-04)

fact_text: The co-founder said Airlift, once described as Pakistan's largest startup, is no longer visible, which he attributed to founders focused on raising funds rather than running a business.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Sunday Bazar to Nationwide Retail: Khazanay’s Journey | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-04)

fact_text: The co-founder said the Pakistani market is large and Khazanay's product is priced for mass affordability, which he argued makes it attractive to capable new entrants.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Sunday Bazar to Nationwide Retail: Khazanay’s Journey | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-04)

fact_text: The interviewee said basic salary had risen to about 35,000 rupees, alongside higher rents and electricity bills, forcing retail prices to be adjusted.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Sunday Bazar to Nationwide Retail: Khazanay’s Journey | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-04)

fact_text: The interviewee said customers pay for brand trust, citing a $250 shoe that buyers recognise as worth its price as an example of brand value.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Sunday Bazar to Nationwide Retail: Khazanay’s Journey | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-04)
